records.def: PROVISIONAL — The behavioral domain concerned with acquiring, evaluating, organizing, and applying understanding.
records.body: PROVISIONAL — In coherent expression, a person seeks reliable information, distinguishes observation from assumption, updates beliefs when evidence changes, and applies learning with appropriate humility. Distortion may appear as certainty without evidence, information hoarding, intellectual avoidance, or using knowledge to dominate rather than understand. These are proposed operational distinctions, not source-verified ATÜNED claims.

These are proposed operational distinctions, not source-verified ATÜNED claims.
